balls.text: this is short, Badri gives it an almighty heave but ends up slicing it to extra cover, where another catch has been taken, which is surprising going by Bangalore's fielding effort in the day
top shot, makes room, gets on a knee, and goes inside-out on this length ball. Good to watch
sees him charge at him, pushes this wide of off, Hussey connects with the open face but can't beat point
slower short ball with the mid-off up, hit towards the same fielder
nice yorker, just a single for Hussey

However, Bangalore hold onto one! Morkel again plays a poor shot in what has been an unremarkable innings, Agarwal runs from long-on to his right to complete the catch. Morkel struggled to time throughout his effort. Vettori applauds the effort. Is he being sarcastic? I would suppose not
makes room, Zaheer follows him, pulled away for one. A good over for Bangalore
another slog from Morkel, and ends up swinging at thin air
bunted into the on side where all the fielders are back on the boundary, and they run back hard for a couple
ahh, ugly slog, gets a bottom edge back to Zaheer
hit down the ground this time, gets a single to long-on
Hussey's favourite pull shot. Gets to 80 now. Again set himself up early, as if he knows Zaheer is going to bowl short, and places it perfectly square of long leg
full delivery, hit to long-on for one
Hussey can't get out today! no he can't. Another mis-hit this time, and it goes inches straight of a diving Agarwal at long-on. what's more? it bounces over for four too
Dilshan provides Bangalore fielders a hint of redemption. Hussey nicely squeezes this yorker fine of third man but a diving Dilshan saves two runs

another drop! Bangalore won't be able to catch a cold at North Pole. Slower ball from van der Wath, and Hussey skies it towards sweeper-cover where Asad Patahan - yes, you guessed it - misjudges, doesn't get into position, and lets it through his butter fingers
length ball, gentle pace, outside off, Hussey makes room and lofts him over point. van der Wath can't keep bowling length at his pace
angling too straight, Morkel gets a deflection wide of keeper and fine of the very square fine leg
full, not quite the yorker, but can't get under this one, and Hussey drives it along the ground to long-off
stays back, pushes it to cover, hands the strike over

Zak gets his own back. Goes round the wicket, angles it in, gets it to hold its line the slightest bit, thus getting the slight outside edge from Dhoni, who walks. rarely does Zaheer not have the final word
watch out sight screen operators! One of the flattest sixes you will see. Length ball all right, but Dhoni has given it some whack straight over the umpire's head
slower bouncer, Dhoni, his India captain, is waiting. And not the smartest delivery when third man is up. Dhoni guides it over the man
poor bowling, full, on the pads, fine leg is up. Hussey gets it past that man
no room here and Hussey defends it back to Kohli

nice shot, but the fielding is not so nice. Makes room and cuts this over extra cover where Asad Pathan lets it through his legs. Kohli is not pleased. Bangalore have been poor in the field, except for Kohli
almost gets a wicket off a thigh-high full toss. Dhoni gives it his all, and ends up slicing it towards long-off, but it falls just short
makes room and pushes a full delivery down to long-off
forces this into the covers for one
that's not a good parting shot from Vettori. Full, flat, outside leg, and Hussey helps it along its way over short fine leg

slog-sweep! Hussey rearranges Vettori's figures a bit. It seems Hussey had made up his mind that this was going no matter where it landed. Just cleared the front leg, and was happy to see the length ball. Over midwicket
stays back to push a flat delivery down the ground
looks to sweep from outside leg, misses, and gets a leg-bye. To short third man!
hit powerfully but straight down to long-on
AB has missed a stumping here? Hussey makes room and comes down, Vettori fires it in. AB is possibly blind-sighted as he can't even collect the ball. Concedes a bye too
short delivery, pulled to deep midwicket for one
athletic off his own bowling, dives to his lift on the practice pitch and saves a single
short of a length, around off, pushed down to long-off
gets an inside edge onto the pad as he looks to sweep, will get a single
played down to long-off for one
length ball on the pads, worked away for one
full on the pads, gets a single to long-on
pushed wide of Vettori, who would have saved it had Hussey not been in his way. However, the non-striker was not out of line in being where he was
slower through the air this time, Dhoni has too long to wait, and loses his shape as he looks to power this down the ground. Dot ball again
charges at him, and ends up yorking himself
shortish, bludgeoned away straight to extra cover
short, on the pads, pulled away to deep backward square for one
pushes at this one in front of his body, did the ball stop a touch too? However, the ball chips inches above extra cover, and Dhoni takes another couple
nicely done, placed with soft hands into the on side, and sprints back for two
slower, fuller, worked away off the pads for one
misses out. This is short and wide and there is no third man, but he can't pierce the infield with the cut
gets off the mark right away, pushing one to sweeper-cover
short ball, pulled away for one
Hussey pushes this down to long-off for one

too much greed! Looks for another big shot, but clearly is not close enough the pitch of the ball, and thus ends up looking to drag it onto the on side. The shot just hands in the air, and slices off towards extra cover, where Agarwal, one of the few Bangaloreans in the team, completes the catch
poor fielding at extra cover, this was hit straight at him, and through him
and the best shot of the three! Comes down the ground and also makes room, and then lofts him over extra cover
more effort behind this one, and more runs too. Takes half a step down the track, and flicks it powerfully over wide long-on. All the power comes from wrists here
full toss on the pads, and Raina nicely lofts it over midwicket. Easy does it
comes down the track to push it to long-off for another single
this would have been a wide had he not played at it. As it turns out, he gets a bottom edge for one
short delivery, hit powerfully and uppishly down the ground, bounces in front of long-off
worked away into the leg side for one
reverse sweep, nay reverse pull! Gets into position early, not all the way down, just bent at the knee, and then slaps it towards what would have been point. Innovations
keeps this one slow in the air even though the batsmen is charging at him, gets an inside edge, but it still accounts for a single
nicely tossed up again, and driven down the ground again, and Kohli does the fielding again
driven to long-off for another single
comes down the track, plays inside out, but Kohli is electric at long-off. Some other fielders might have conceded two here
quicker delivery, Raina opens the face but can't beat short third man
sees him coming at hime, and pushes this wide of off, Hussey manages to get bat to it and chips it wide of long-off for one
nicely tossed up, pushed down to long-off for one
shuffles inside the line of a short delivery and helps it away to fine leg for one
this was the mean bouncer, like he meant it this time, 140ks, Tony Hill calls it a wide for height. No country for fast men
nice shot, making room, backing away, and opening the face on a chest-high delivery, getting it fine of third man. Not much wrong with this delivery
shimmies down the track, sees the slower ball, and pushes it wide of cover for one
goes for another pull, but this doesn't bounce enough, and passes under his bat
pulled away off the front foot, Hussey seems to like van der Wath's lack of pace and is setting himself up for the pull every time
slower ball, dropped towards cover, and they steal a single
more pre-meditation, reverse-sweep this time, gets a full toss, connects it, puts pressure on deep point, comes back for two
looks for the sweep, misses, hit on the pad
full outside off, pushed to long-off

Brave, brave bowling. He flights it again, inviting Vijay to go for another six. Vijay obliges, looking for a replay of the previous shot, nearly gets it right. It's a matter of inches here, not close enough to the pitch of the ball, and hence gets more height on it than distance. Zaheer at long-off makes no mistake
no getting away this time. Lovely shot from Vijay. Comes down the track, gets suitably close to the pitch of the ball, and lofts it over long-off
Ryan Ninan tosses up a gentle full toss first ball, and it goes to extra cover on half-volley. Gets away with it
pushed wide of the diving Dilshan for one to long-on
which is just as well as Hussey sweeps again, the sweeper makes sure this is just one
fuller, on middle and leg, and Hussey sweeps this this time, over square leg. Runs have come a bit too easy in the last two overs
Hussey has been setting up for the pull, and this shows why. He manufactures another pull and there is no one back on the leg side. Worth the risk as this one gets four
into the pads, worked away to deep square for one
flat, shortish delivery on off, Hussey bottom-edges a pull
Vijay is definitely not looking the gift horse in the mouth. Another gentle length ball on the pads, and this time he goes further, clearing the ropes. First six of the innings

when it rains, it pours. Poor bowling follows up poor fielding. The world just doesn't seem right to van der Wath. Gentle hit-me delivery on the pads with short fine leg up. Vijay lofts it duly over that fielder
Vijay rubs salt into wounds, by cross-batting this length delivery wide of Kaif at mid-on
full on middle and leg, played back to the bowler

Bangalore are fielding poorly here! Kaif this time. One of the better fielders in domestic cricket. Hussey looks to loft over mid-off, mishits, Kaif runs back, gets under it, still running back, and lets it through his hands
Hussey looks to pull, and there is length to do so, but he finds midwicket with this one
full on pads again, this time it is defended to square leg

and more cat and mouse. Vettori bowls a leg-side yorker again, Vijay stands his ground and helps it around the corner. Around the corner, the short fine leg misfields, conceding four where there should have been none
more cat and mouse. Vijay stands way outside leg stump for this, Vettori follows him, and yorks him again
yorks him as Vijay looks to make room
slows this one down a bit, and Hussey taps it for one into the leg side
full on the pads, looks for the little paddle, finds short fine

Pujara conceded an overthrow in the last over. Now he has flown across at extra cover and saved three runs. This one was walloped by Hussey, to the left of extra cover, but Pujara was too alert and agile for it
placed wide of mid-on for a single, cautious start from Vijay
looks to drive, can't beat cover
length ball, around off, defended
hit to mid-on who is deep and thus allows them a single
smashed it, absolutely smashed it, dancing down the track and lofting him over mid-on, as if Zaheer was a spinner

That is close, really close. Full, flat, fast, Hussey seems to have been beaten as he turns the bat face on it. Tony Hill, though, shakes his head right away. That had to be close. Replays suggest it pitched inches outside leg
comes down the track, and pushes this to midwicket
the arm ball, fast and furious, Vijay takes it on, cutting it off the stumps, can't beat backward point. Pujara, though, lobs the throw over the keeper's head. Extra conceded
too straight this time, Vijay turns his wrists late and gets himself a couple, wide of deep midwicket
slightly slower, pushed cautiously to mid-on
fires in a fullish delivery, no turn, played with the angle to square leg
just back of a length, width available, but the punch from Hussey can't beat backward point
width there, but not cutting length, and Hussey gets a bottom edge into the ground. The ball bounces off towards the keeper
similar length, angling in towards off, Hussey gets behind it and defends
full delivery, around off, pushed to cover-point
nicely tucked away off the pads, wide of mid-on, gets a single
Hussey starts off well, opening the face on a widish delivery, getting a single to third man
and Chennai complete the comprehensive win with a slower bouncer, the top edge, though, falls safe
length ball this time, he lofts it over extra for four
again a yorker, another single, these will do Chennai's net run-rate some good too
near-yorker again, single taken
yorker on off, single taken
...there's the single, down to long-on. Now for five sixes
short ball, pulled straight to square leg, takes a single
oh length ball again, tempting his fate again, but van der Wath again swings inside the line
better length, near yorker, but too wide outside off
length again, wide too, it was ripe for the taking, but he just swung inside the line
Hello? Length ball from a fellow Saffer, and van der Wath lofts it over midwicket. Perfect length for that shot. Length ball, at medium pace, enough said

never mind losing the strike, he has lost his wicket. Game, set, match. It was a good inside-out shot, but he just placed it straight down the throat of sweeper-cover. Chennai have two points in the bag
wide and full, mis-hit, but he gets it over point, comes back for two. The moment he loses strike here might also be the game for Chennai
the short ball again, too good for van der Wath. He doesn't know whether to duck or to pull. Dot ball
slower short ball, de Villiers completely loses shape on this, and all he can manage is a single to point
and they run two again, this is superb running. He just digs out a yorker towards mid-on, and hares back
full delivery, hit wide of long-on, comes back for two

What a shot! Every once in a while, this game shows you things you have never seen in years of watching cricket. Read this carefully: ABD has reverse-swept Southee, bowling at least at 130ks, for a six. This is no edge, no mis-hit, calculated, predetermined, reverse scoop, and how well he has connected it off a length
nice shot, de Villiers shuffles way across, takes this from well wide of off, and scoops it over short fine. Fifty up for ABD, but he knows there is a lot more to be done
drives a full delivery to extra cover. Dot ball, required rate crosses three per ball
slower through the air, pushed square for one
Pujara plays the pressure shot, jumping out of the crease, toe-ending towards the 30-yard circle, Vijay runs flat out from long-on and makes the catch. He is pumped, Chennai are pumped
swept away, will get just a single to deep square
especially if they keep fielding like this. Ashwin makes a full-length diving save at long-off to save two runs
Pujara comes down the track, converts this into a full toss, but hits it straight to long-on for one
places this wide of point to get off the mark
nearly stumped, well bowled. Sees him coming, keeps this short, Dhoni is expecting a stumping as it beats him, but it also takes the thigh pad along the way
finally connects with the sweep, and places it between the two deep fielders on the leg side. They will need more of these
looks to go inside-out, gets the inside half of the bat towards square leg, fits in a couple
wide down the leg side, and they squeeze in a bye too
worked into the leg side, they can't afford dot balls
goes for the big sweep, misses, takes a leg-bye

and he seems to have stolen one here! Extra bouncer from Randiv again, pitches just outside leg, beats the flick, and seems to have lobbed off the thigh pad to Dhoni. Umpire Dharmasena, though, agrees with the fielders. Of course I will stand corrected if the replays show otherwise
pushed wide of off, a diving Hussey at extra cover keeps them down to one
muscular hit over cover, but gets just a single to the sweeper in the deep
yorks him, concedes just a single
AB misses on the slog-sweep. Extra bounce is the reason, and it also is the reason why the middle stump is still standing
full outside off, driven for one. AB back on strike
flat, full toss, and de Villiers sweeps this between deep square and deep midwicket. This ain't over yet
no one can stick a boot out to this one. AB charges down again, and this time lofts him well over, and I mean well over, midwicket
brave fielding! de Villiers had hammered this back down the ground, but Jakati stuck his right foot out
another single to midwicket, and again Tiwary plonks his bat in. No direct-hit this time
too much indecision, it seemed. Made room, looked like shaping to go inside-out, changed his mind at the last moment and swept, and gets just a leg-bye
cut away square of short third for a single
into the pads, worked away for a single
darted well down the leg side, well done by Dhoni
placed fine of a very square fine leg, and comes back for an easy second
angled into the pads, plonks his bat in as he takes a single to square leg, but is alert enough to steal the overthrow
shortish, hurrying onto him as he looks to pull, gets a single to midwicket
drops and runs, gets a single to point
flat, angling in, pushed between long-on and deep midwicket for two
this one turns away, and Tiwary punches it to sweeper-cover for one
nicely bowled, Tiwary waits for the ball to turn before he can open the face, but the ball keeps going on with the angle, cramping the batsman up
pauses in the delivery stride, bowls flat, pulled to midwicket for one
short and wide, cut away for one
full, and fired into the pads, gets a leg-bye
and AB reverse-sweeps, wide of point, gets four. Lovely connection
throws his hands at a wide delivery, ends up slicing it over point, gets three
darted down the leg side, and rightly called wide despite Dhoni's big appeal

Smart bowling. Jakati has been targetted by Kohli, but he has gone over the wicket and stifled Kohli. This time he sees the batsman charge at him, and bowls full and outside leg, Kohli gets a top edge as he looks to go over the on side, and Aniruddha runs to his right from long-on to complete the catch
AB comes down the track and mis-hits this one towards long-on. He has mis-hit it enough to make sure it doesn't carry to the fielder
comes down the track, plays it to long-off for one
Kohli looks to go inside-out, finds extra cover
they will want Kohli to do what he just did: come down the track, to the pitch of the ball, and smash the ball straight of long-on. No chance of stopping it
on the pads, worked away for one
full and wide across him, driven to sweeper-cover for one
the gentler cut, the deft one, using Randiv's pace, gets a single to wide of short third
top shot from Kohli. This is short, going across with the angle, and Kohli cuts it in front of square, wide of sweeper-cover
driven powerfully to long-on for a single

Randiv nearly gets AB! This is the arm ball, I suspect. AB comes down the track, thinking he will loft an offbreak over long-on. The arm ball is sliced high towards long-off, but falls in no man's land
lovely shot, making room, opening the face, all along the ground, straight of extra cover, wide of long-off. Four of the best runs you get to see
flat, quick, played back to the bowler
places it wide of extra for one
hit straight to mid-on, another dot
another carrom ball, and an lbw appeal as de Villers is foxed. Dharmasena reckons it is pitched outside leg. Dhoni disagrees. He makes the DRS review signal
carrom ball, gets a leading edge, back to the bowler
chips down the track, gets a single to deep midwicket. Along the ground
they have decided Jakati is the bowler to go. Makes room here, waits for Jakati to follow him, and then pulls it over midwicket. Two bounces into the fence
another misfield, at extra cover, concedes a single
angled into the pads, worked away for a single
flighted delivery, pays inside-out for a single
and gets a royal welcome to the crease as Kohli charges at him and crashes him for a flat six over the leaping long-on
nice chip shot towards cow corner, comes back for two
looks to cut this one, but this seems to be the arm ball, and has bounced too. Beaten
shortish, pulled away, settle for a single despite a fumble by Vijay
full, middle and leg, worked away for one
another short towards short fine, this time they chance the single, but Kohli makes it despite a direct hit
sharp offbreak, played straight to short fine
lovely shot, but even better fielding. Square-drive from AB, but a diving save at point saves four runs. Badrinath is the man
looks to open face on this one, but makes no contact
runs a widish delivery down to third man
back of a length, outside off, Kohli pushes it back to the bowler
slower offcutter, runs it down to third man for one
de Villiers charges at Morkel, who bowls it wide of off, and the batsman pushes it to point
turning into the pads, played straight to the straightish midwicket

Ashwin strikes in his first over. This was a-coming. Agarwal hasn't really felt in, and two dot balls in a row were asking for an adventurous shot. Agarwal tried to go over mid-off, never quite got close to the pitch of the ball, and ended up skying it. Morkel takes a decent catch running back
flatter, middle and leg, played back to the bowler
arm ball, tossed up outside off, Agarwal throws his hands at it but ends up swinging inside the line because it doesn't turn
a bit more air, hit down to long-on for one
shortish delivery, hit to square leg
slight shape in, towards top of off, pushed back to the bowler. Good over again
punched away off the hip again, Vijay makes a diving save at midwicket, keeping them down to one
slightly slower, hit straight to mid-off, along the ground
punched away off the hips, but straight to midwicket
smart shot or outside edge? Mix of both. Kohli looks to drive, realises he is not close to it, and opens his face a bit, and the thick edge flies wide of Dhoni. No slip there
back of a length, around off, pushed to mid-on
slower ball again, pushed to cover, no run
a better cover drive this time, along the ground, also straight to extra cover
slower ball, false shot, but it flies over cover. the benefits of giving it your all
another misfield, Raina this time, at point. Another single stolen. This one didn't bounce as high as Raina expected it to
misfield at point, they steal a single
worked away off the stumps, towards square leg for one
on target, no room, played to point
back of a length, on the pads, pushed to mid-on
played with an open face, can't beat point
and what a day for fielding. Hussey has dropped a dolly! It was actually a hit-me on Kohli's pads, who flicked it straight to square leg, but Hussey's hands closed a split-second too early

bowled him! Pathan had done so well hitting down the ground so far, but inexplicably, as if under pressure to keep up with modern times, he tries the scoop over the keeper's head, thus moving too far across the stumps, and leaving the stumps prone. top of middle
sharp bouncer as he sees Pathan move across. Too high, though. Wide
and Agarwal hands it over to Pathan by dropping it to cover for one
Pathan is smoking some here. Shuffling across the line to every delivery, and connecting cleanly. This one is just short of a length, and he smites it over cow corner
shuffles across again, and is beaten by a short ball outside off
Pathan means business here. Moves across again, Morkel bowls full, and he crashes it wide of mid-on. All along the ground. Is this the redemption song for Pathan?
premeditates a pull first ball, moving across the line and then lofting it between mid-on and midwicket
out first ball! Soft dismissal really. Full, on the pads, four runs... Not quite, bat face turn a split second too early, and the leading edge goes straight to midwicket
angling into the pads, placed wide of mid-on for a single
